title: Microsoft will block MSIX and MSIXBundle attachments in Outlook and Exchange Online starting November 2026 to prevent malware distribution.
content_md:
Microsoft will block MSIX and MSIXBundle attachments in Outlook and Exchange Online starting November 2026 to prevent malware distribution. 

via Mastodon http://securityonline.info/outlook-msix-attachment-block/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=jetpack_social
